title: Refund of Credit Balances and Small-Balance Write-Offs (Commercial Credit Account)
content:
A refund is issued on a Commercial Credit Account only when the account's receivable balance is a credit balance of at least the tier's refund minimum and no dispute on the account is open. The account's receivable balance and its dispute history in the system record decide.

### Refund

- The refund equals the whole credit balance and is paid by the tier's refund method.
- A smaller credit balance stays on account and is drawn on by the next invoice.

### Small-balance write-off

- A residual invoice balance of the tier's small-balance maximum or less is written off once the invoice is more than the tier's minimum age in days past due.
- A residual above that amount is never written off and stays collectible, and a balance under an open dispute is never written off.

### Judgement table

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| credit balance at or above the refund minimum, no open dispute | the whole credit balance is refunded by the tier's method |
| credit balance at or above the minimum, a dispute open | no refund |
| credit balance below the minimum | stays on account |
| residual at or below the write-off maximum, invoice more than the minimum age past due, not disputed | written off |
| residual above the write-off maximum | never written off; stays collectible |

*Hypothetical:* on a tier with a refund minimum of 25.00, a credit balance of 25.00 with no open dispute is refunded in full; 24.99 stays on account. On a tier with a 5.00 maximum and 90 days, a residual of 4.20 on an invoice 90 days past due is not yet written off; at 91 days it is.
